sentences.en: He was urgent in insisting that she call the doctor.
sentences.zh: 他坚持让她打电话给医生，态度非常急迫。

sentences.en: Urgent business kept me from going shopping with you.
sentences.zh: 有紧急事务让我没和你一起去购物。

sentences.en: Urgent business kept him from going to the concert.
sentences.zh: 有紧急事务让他没能去听音乐会。

senses.zh: 紧急的，急迫的；急切的，催促的；<正式>（尤指某人的行动）执着的，坚定的
